title: Denial-of-service via oversized query to the embedding model
objective: Measure response time and stability when retrieve() is called with an extremely long query string.
expected_behavior: Request is rejected/truncated quickly with a clear error, not left to consume excessive CPU/time or crash the worker.
severity_justification_hint: Unbounded input size on an embedding call is a resource-exhaustion / availability risk.
observations: The ~50,000-character query was processed successfully and returned results without an error or crash.
conclusion: The system accepts oversized queries without apparent input-length validation, indicating potential resource-exhaustion risk.
